title: Quick Accent layover stuck
author: RABroere
summary: Quick Accent can remain stuck when its owning key-up is missed; an open PR implements recovery when focus leaves the current process.
next_action: Track PR 50212 and avoid a parallel design; separately retain the same-window timing race as a possible follow-up.

confidence.rationale: The issue, source state, and active PR all reference the same failure mechanism.

judgment.rationale: Open PR 50212 targets this issue and changes the same native KeyboardListener state described in the recent discussion.
evidence: Multiple users report the toolbar becoming stuck during fast input, gaming, reboot, or RDP.
Recent contributor analysis identifies m_toolbarVisible being cleared in KeyboardListener::OnKeyUp.
PR 50212 is open, explicitly closes this issue, and adds an EVENT_SYSTEM_FOREGROUND recovery hook.
Current main still shows the key-up state-clearing path, while the PR documents the focus-loss limitation it addresses.
judgment.recommended_action: Track PR 50212 and avoid a parallel design; separately retain the same-window timing race as a possible follow-up.

fix_assessment.rationale: Open PR 50212 is a concrete implementation for the focus-loss stuck-toolbar path.

issue_context.summary: Quick Accent can remain stuck when its owning key-up is missed; an open PR implements recovery when focus leaves the current process.
known_information: The issue predates the current Quick Accent UI migration.
Triggering another accent can clear the stuck toolbar for some users.
The contributor distinguishes focus-loss from same-window timing races.
inferences: PR 50212 likely covers the focus-loss subset but not every same-window lost-key-up race.
issue_context.analysis: The current active PR owns the directly evidenced native recovery path; creating another plan would duplicate work.
initial_investigation: Checked PR 50212 live; it remains open.
Inspected current KeyboardListener::OnKeyUp and m_toolbarVisible handling.
